effect_description_eng:
[On Play] 1 of your [Marcus Damon] is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon that can't digivolve and gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
[All Turns] When this Tamer becomes suspended, 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. If you have a Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
